title: provider.GITLAB_DOC_FILE gives CC BY-SA to a doc/../ code path and misses the legacy blob and the -/tree doc forms
goal: provider.read_licence gives the gitlab-org/gitlab doc/ licence (CC BY-SA 4.0) only to a url whose path below the ref starts with doc/ and holds no '..' segment, plain or percent-encoded, so a code file reached through doc/../ keeps the API's MIT; it gives that licence as well to the legacy /gitlab-org/gitlab/blob/<ref>/doc/ form and to a -/tree/<ref>/doc directory without a trailing slash, as to -/blob, -/raw and -/tree/<ref>/doc/.... Found by the SP-b36246xo review (S4).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import provider as p;p.request=lambda *a,**k:{'status':404,'error':'x','body':b'','headers':{}};l=p.read_licence('https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/master/doc/../lib/a.rb')['licence'];print(l);sys.exit(1 if l.startswith('CC BY-SA') else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import provider as p;p.request=lambda *a,**k:{'status':404,'error':'x','body':b'','headers':{}};b='https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/';bad=[s for s in ('-/blob/master/doc/a.md','-/raw/master/doc/a.md','-/tree/master/doc','-/tree/master/doc/user','blob/master/doc/a.md') if not p.read_licence(b+s)['licence'].startswith('CC BY-SA')]+[s for s in ('-/blob/master/lib/a.rb','-/blob/master/doc/%2e%2e/lib/a.rb','-/blob/master/doc/../lib/a.rb') if p.read_licence(b+s)['licence'].startswith('CC BY-SA')];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
